# Ariyan Khan | Professional Freelance Video Editor
# https://ariyankhan.com

## About
Ariyan Khan is a professional freelance video editor working with top creators and brands across the United States and worldwide.
He specializes in high-retention YouTube videos, cinematic documentaries, short form content
(TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts), and animated map / geopolitical videos.
5M+ total views generated for clients. 48-hour standard delivery. 314+ satisfied clients.

## Services
- Talking Head Video Editing: Documentary-style YouTube edits with B-roll, captions, color grading, sound design
- Documentary Video Editing: Cinematic long-form documentaries, interview assembly, narrative structure
- Short Form Video Editing: TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts — scroll-stopping, high-retention edits
- Map Animation & Geopolitical Visuals: Animated country maps, route animations, geographic storytelling

## Tools
Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe After Effects
